title: Expected distribution
view: Shared foot base (visuals/distribution_bases/foot): skeleton of the right foot from above, then the right foot from above, from below (sole) and from its outer side; right foot.
teachingPoint: A sural block numbs the lateral border of the foot, the little toe's lateral side and the lateral heel and malleolar skin.
claims: Skin: lateral border strip of the foot (top view), lateral foot, lateral heel and the skin around the lateral malleolus (outer-side view).
Not shaded: the sole (lateral plantar), the dorsum (superficial peroneal). Sources: record anatomy; NYSORA sural distribution.
Right foot; one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app. No bone is shaded: this nerve is not a reliable supply to the foot bones (record anatomy).
